clips.title: The story
paras: In Redridge, Shadowhide Pendant charms pass among gnolls working with Morganth. Lakeshire accepts ten as proof that its law has been enforced.

Shadowhide Pendant charms pass among the Shadowhide warriors, brutes, and spellcasters. Deep in Redridge's hills, the clan has gathered under Lieutenant Fangore and fallen under the sway of Morganth, a rogue wielder of the Arcane. To Lakeshire's townspeople, the crude charms mark an organized threat harassing settlements for an enemy of the Crown.

Stormwind law, upheld by Magistrate Solomon, sets death as the sentence for actively aiding a known criminal of the realm. Royal reinforcements are too few, so Bailiff Conacher at Lakeshire Town Hall relies on adventurers to keep the peace. Ten Shadowhide Pendants prove that gnolls obeying Morganth's orders have faced frontier justice.
